brief.question: Do the independent angular, scalar and two-stage York inverse primitives pass the preregistered analytic, origin, tail, norm, flux and refinement controls?
brief.healthy: One standard-library CPU process. 26 angular controls, 9 scalar controls, 12 York case-levels, then export. Full source/level/comparison records are checkpointed. Coarse physical comparison failures marked acceptance_required=false are diagnostics, not failed mandatory gates.
brief.noise: No mixed gravitational H6 or one-loop amplitude is computed. The parent H6 number is not a comparison metric. Source/volume progress can take time between complete York cases; the driver enforces 1800 s and sampled 2 GiB RSS.
brief.worth_a_flag: A mandatory comparison fails, an exception or work cap is reported, or a stage stops producing source/volume progress for several minutes. Preserve measured failures; do not relax tolerances.
